List Runs For Project.description: Lists runs in a project, e.g. for a monitoring workflow that alerts on failed runs.

Get Run.description: Fetches one run by id to check its state and timing.
Get Run.code:
// Get a single run by id.
get(`runs/${$.data.runId}`);

List Projects.description: Lists the OpenFn projects the API token can access.
List Projects.code:
// List projects visible to this API token.
get('projects');

List Workflows.description: Lists workflows, e.g. to build an inventory of integrations across projects.

List Jobs.description: Lists jobs (steps) in a project, with paging.

List Credentials.description: Lists credentials the token can see, e.g. for a periodic access audit.
